gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients must have histologically confirmed IDH wildtype World Health Organization (WHO) grade IV glioblastoma at first or second relapse

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II trial compares the safety, side effects and effectiveness of atezolizumab with tiragolumab to atezolizumab alone in treating patients with glioblastoma that has come back after a period of improvement (recurrent).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Trough concentrations in serum and concentrations in cerebrospinal fluid: Pharmacokinetics exposure values will be reported descriptively.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: I. To evaluate the impact of atezolizumab, tiragolumab, or their combination on tumor infiltrating T lymphocyte (TIL) density in glioblastoma patients.
Tumor infiltrating T-cell, T-regs, and myeloid cells: Specific immune cell populations and ratios in tumor tissue will be compared between the groups using a non-parametric test

role_evidence.quote: GROUP A (neoadjuvant atezolizumab, tiragolumab): Patients receive atezolizumab IV over 60 minutes and tiragolumab IV over 20-75 minutes and 14-19 days later, undergo surgical resection.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as atezolizumab and tiragolumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer

coder_notes: Four randomised groups: A neoadjuvant atezolizumab+tiragolumab, B tiragolumab, C atezolizumab, D no neoadjuvant drug (ACTIVE_COMPARATOR). Post-surgery adjuvant atezolizumab (+/- tiragolumab) may be given in all groups, so atezolizumab is also given in the comparator arm after surgery; coded experimental_combination per Group A. Registered intervention lists for Group B and D include both antibodies. Biomarker rows other than IDH are exploratory/pharmacodynamic only; candidate_matched on checkpoint expression row is a mechanistic link (PD-L1/TIGIT) and does not affect the primary outcome.
